Facebook / Instagram caption

20 years. Thousands of rooms. One promise: five-star clean. ⭐ 3 rooms for $99 + a free hallway. Carpet · upholstery · tile · pet odor · Airbnb turnovers (480) 709-2006 #MesaAZ #CarpetCleaning #UpholsteryCleaning #Since2005

Website article

Upholstery cleaning: what 20 years taught us 1. Check the tag. W means water-based cleaning is safe, S means solvent only, WS means either. We read it before we start. 2. Sunscreen and body oil are the hidden stain. Arm rests and headrests darken slowly; a deep clean brings back the original color. 3. Pets live on the couch. Odor sits in the cushion foam, not just the fabric, so we treat both. 4. Dry time matters. Most sofas are ready to use the same day. Book an upholstery cleaning at (480) 709-2006.
